_note: Where the results desk looks, per competition, in trust order. Read with normal page requests only: respect robots.txt and terms, never work around bot protection or logins. If a source blocks automated reading, skip it and say so. Never use sites named in Milestone Games' June 2026 KPL data lawsuit (Sofascore, FotMob, LiveScore, OneFootball, ESPN, Superport) as KPL sources.

kenyan-premier-league.officialNames: Use the team names exactly as FKF's table writes them (Tusker, 3K, Kenya Police, KCB, Murang'a Seal) so reconcile can match.
kenyan-premier-league.notes: FKF's fixtures page lists only upcoming rounds; finished-round dates and venues come from the round's announced schedule (secondary outlets). FKF writes 'Nyayo Stadium' — the venue list uses 'Nyayo National Stadium'.

official.fixtures: https://www.kenyacup.co.ke/kenya-cup-2025-26-season/ (one page per season; find the new one on kenyacup.co.ke)

kenya-cup.officialNames: Use kenyacup.co.ke's spellings (KCB Rugby, KU BlakBlad, Nondescript RFC, Kenya Harlequin FC, MMUST).
kenya-cup.notes: Tables include try and losing bonus points (+1 for 4+ tries, +1 for losing by 7 or fewer; from outlets, not a KRU document), so reconcile can't rebuild them: --skip-reconcile and take standings from the official table. The official fixtures page gives no kick-off times and few venues. 2026/27 expected to start in November (Kabras Sugar v KCB Rugby); Mwamba RFC and JKUAT Cougars promoted, Kisumu RFC and MMUST relegated (KRU, 10 Jun 2026). Start a new season in admin before entering 2026/27 — server/jobs/syncKenyaCup.js writes standings into whichever season is current.

khu-premier-league.officialNames: Use the KHU's spellings: Butali Warriors, Western Jaguars, Sikh Union Nairobi, Kenya Police, Parklands Sports Club, Kisumu Youngsters, USIU – A (spaced en dash), Greensharks, Daikyo Heroes, Wazalendo.
secondary: mozzartsport.co.ke (hockey reporting; owned by a betting firm — corroboration only)
khu-premier-league.notes: Rule 3/1/0 (derived: every official row is Pts = 3W + D). The KHU calendar gives dates and times but no venues; venues come from news, one outlet each. Three USIU – A results are listed by KHU as 5-0 (apparently awarded) where The Standard reported other scores — the KHU figure is what the official table uses. HockeyKE (hockeyke.com) is third-party, renders client-side and was ~3.5 months stale on 2026-10-17: don't use it as a source.

secondary: afrobasket.com (third-party; the only full regular-season table found, W-L only)
kbf-premier-league.notes: No KBF website or KBF-published table or results found (2026-10-17). Every score needs two different outlets. Table points are 2 per win, 1 per loss (consistent with The Standard's and Citizen's published figures; no rulebook found). Playoff games share the competition, so never rebuild the table from results — enter the regular-season table directly. Citizen calls the league 'KNBL' / 'National Men's Basketball Premier League' (possible rebrand, unconfirmed). Scores often pass 100.

official.overview: https://footballkenya.org/leagues (find the NSL table/fixtures pages from here)

national-super-league.notes: As of 2026-10-17 the 2026/27 NSL hasn't started: FKF's NSL pages still show 2025/26, and 19 clubs have asked for it not to start until they meet the FKF president. Kariobangi Sharks relegated from the KPL (FKF ruling, 9 Oct 2026). A 25 Oct kick-off appeared only on a betting-firm site — not confirmed. FKF Cup: next edition not yet drawn; Division One: no official tables published.
